211. Orgal's Negotiation (2)
Zephyrin did not completely deny that remark.
"One of the heads... that would depend on who you think owns the body that the great serpent possesses. After all, there were nine heads in the first place."
"Hey, demon dragon. It's simple in such cases. The head that owns the body now is the owner. Weren't you weaker than Lord Ameris and fell off like a grape?"
"Well, it may seem that way right now. Anyway, you're back again without any courtesy. My master should have warned you enough last time."
"I've been trading with Bishukel for quite some time now. You're late in paying the price, so it would be nice if you don't spout nonsense about settling with me again."
"I always feel this whenever I meet you, Lord Jin, but you're really unpleasant. You think you've reaped plenty of rewards just by fending off some of the Enemy Tribe's riff-raff a few times."
"A promise is a promise."
"All we have to do is tell you how we're bringing the demons as a tribute, right? By circumventing the Sealed Magic Wall that the Great Serpent is guarding."
Surprisingly, Zephyrin brought up the main point straight away. She had regained some of her ancient memories while unconscious due to Ameris.
"Oh, that's refreshing. I didn't expect you to bring up the Sealed Magic Wall first."

"It's not such a big secret now. Since all information about the underworld has already been disclosed to the public, it's only a matter of time before the identity of the Sealed Magic Wall and those who live under it is revealed."
When the opponent starts pouring out information voluntarily, it usually means one thing.
They have something they want. Despite it being the price of the trade, Zephyrin could be as passive in the conversation as she wanted if she put her mind to it.
"The Sealed Magic Wall is already partially destroyed, Lord Jin. Ameris probably doesn't remember this fact. So, she would've told you to find out how we are managing to control the demons."
"It's already partially destroyed?"

"The ancient royal tribes, the Blue Tribe and the Enemy Tribe, destroyed it. At the time, Ameris hastily repaired the Sealed Magic Wall... but by then, some of the demons living underground had already escaped to the intermediate world. Somewhere between the surface and the underworld, so to speak."
"So, the demons that Kinzel is controlling now are not from the complete underworld, but the demons that were living in the intermediate world?"

"Yes, so Ameris couldn't possibly know. They were not originally from beneath the Sealed Magic Wall. The same goes for the Enemy Tribe. They were able to emerge because they were not living under the Sealed Magic Wall."
The intermediate world.
Zephyrin described the space between the surface and the underworld in that way.
"What about during the Holy Kingdom Defense War?"

"At that time, the demons of the intermediate world and the Sealed Magic Wall were mixed. Unlike our master, the Witch Helrum was a figure who could directly summon the demons from beneath the Sealed Magic Wall…"
As the conversation went on, the questions about the underworld and the demons were growing more and more.
Above all, the most curious point was why Zephyrin was revealing information so cooperatively. It couldn't simply be because she wanted to show off her regained memories.
It was simple to find out what Zephyrin was thinking.
"I see. Alright, let's get up now."
As Jin suddenly stood up as if he was leaving, Zephyrin blinked her eyes.
"Isn't there more to discuss?"

"Oh, there's more? I thought it was over because you kept beating around the bush. Your explanation of how Kinzelo brings the demons was sufficient. Anyway, you guys have no significant interactions with the demons beneath the Sealed Magic Wall. It seems that Orgal is not here either."
Zephyrin glared at Jin and Murakan for a moment, holding back her annoyance.
"What are you looking at, do you want a fight?"
As Murakan made a grimace, Zephyrin sighed.
"…Sigh, it's really tiresome. When did this happen? Since when did we, Kinzelo, start getting tossed around by you guys? Why is it always like this?"
"What are you talking about all of a sudden, are you hurt?"
"Enough, sit back down. We will share most of the information we know about the underworld."
Jin smiled broadly.
"You should have said so from the beginning, Zephyrin. Looking at your attitude, it seems like you have to say something regrettable to us again."
"That's the case. But it won't be just us who will regret it, Lord Jin. Recently, the Sealed Magic Wall is collapsing."
"The Sealed Magic Wall? I've never heard such a thing from Lady Ameris."
"The original number of the Great Serpent's heads was nine. But now, only Ameris possesses the body. There has to be a big difference between the abilities of Ameris before she slept and now."
The Sealed Magic Wall is the boundary that divides the entire surface and underworld. Zephyrin added that the current Ameris can't perfectly detect the entire area.
"What is the evidence that the Sealed Magic Wall is collapsing?"
"The Demon King, Zito. He is regaining his power."
"Zito?"
As Zephyrin signaled, Bianca brought a steel box. Inside it was a huge ring.
"What's this?"
"It's a ring, the seal of the Demon King Zito."
"It looks quite large. If it were a human, it could be used as a belt."
"Look here, at the part where the seal is engraved. Do you see the faint purple light?"
As she said, a purple light was circling around the intricate seal pattern.
"The light of this seal appears when Zito issues commands throughout the demon world. And while we've been storing this seal, this is the first time this has happened."
"Is Zito giving some kind of command to the demons of the underworld? Then, that would mean he has already awoken."

"Since the Holy Kingdom is holding onto his most vital body, even if he's awake, he hasn't fully regained his strength. That's why the light formed on the seal is very faint. We suspect he's just regaining consciousness."
-[One thing I can say for sure is that I can't control any problems arising in Zito's physical body.]
-Even if you could control it, I doubt you would.
-[Even though it might be hard for you to believe anything I say, it's a huge burden for me that he's awakening right now.]
He remembered the conversation he had with Orgal, who was temporarily allied with Kinzelo. Back then, Orgal had even said that Zito was 'a curse for the demons, but a mentor-like figure to him'.
"So, is that why Orgal is not here now, and instead you have come?"
"Yes, as soon as the master regained consciousness, he went to negotiate with the demons beneath the Sealed Magic Wall."
"It sounds like the demons under the Sealed Magic Wall are already in a situation where they can come out."

"For now, only special demons can barely linger in the middle world for a short time. But in a little while, they will soon be able to rise to the surface beyond the middle world. Maybe, all the demons…"
A shadow fell over Zephyrin's face.

She didn't seem to be pretending. If Kinzelo and Zito were completely friendly, they should have kept an eye on his eye in the Holy Kingdom. After all, Orgal knew that Zito's eye was in the Holy Kingdom.

-[Zito was an immortal who wanted to become a new order. He tried to rule the world through pain…... You can say he was a madman you shouldn't get involved with. He was a monster that I, with nine heads at the time, could not guarantee a win against. I don't remember how he died.]
Also, according to Ameris, Zito was a being far from the 'Resurrection of the Sun God'. He could only stand diametrically opposed to Orgal, who wanted the resurrection of the Sun God.
"What kind of negotiation is Orgal trying to have with the demons underground?"
Middle world, near the collapsed Sealed Magic Wall.
With a heavy heart, Orgal walked toward the crack in the Sealed Magic Wall. Depending on who among the Demon Kings underground appeared first in the Middle World, the future of Kinzelo could change.

Someone who opposed Zito had to appear first. If Zito had only just opened his eyes and yet the forces following him were larger, there was a high chance that Kinzelo's great cause would become even more precarious.
[Orgal... Is that you?]
[Paelito, long time no see.]
Paelito, he was the demon who had most fiercely opposed Zito in Orgal's memory. Orgal breathed a sigh of relief inside and reached out to him.
[It's been a long time since I came out to the outside of the Demon World. I like the fact that I met you as soon as I came out.]
Paelito took Orgal's hand.
[You've been ruling over the demons who fell into the Middle World for a long time.]
[So it happened. But who told you that?]
[The witch Heluram, who used to be your lover. Who else could have brought news of you to the Demon World since the big snake fell asleep?]
[Well, that's embarrassing. How are things beneath the Sealed Magic Wall?]

[We're always the same. Despite the long time that has passed, everyone is still dreaming and living of the surface. Now that the Sealed Magic Wall has begun to crumble, it seems that time has come for that long dream to come true…….]
Paelito took a long breath. The air was no different from the underworld, but the fact that it was closer to the surface gave him satisfaction.
[But the answer you want to hear, Orgal, won't be this. You'd be curious about who is currently ruling the Demon World.]
[I thought it would be you. Since you're the first to break through the crack in the Sealed Magic Wall, aren't you the strongest in the Demon World right now?]
[Specify it as the Demon World. The Middle World that the surface currently calls the Demon World is a place where abandoned demons like you live, isn't it?]
Orgal did not answer and once again looked carefully at Paelito.
From the ring on his finger, a faint purple light was circling. It perfectly matched the light flowing from Zito's seal.
That meant Paelito was following Zito's orders.

[In the past, and now. The only king who rules the Demon World is none other than Lord Zito, Orgal. I thought you too had responded to Lord Zito's call and came looking for the crack…... Wasn't that the case?]
